screens.title: Admin Sign-In
screens.description: Go to suewheelerstl.com/admin. Enter your email and click "Send Magic Link." No password — ever.

screens.title: Enter Your Email
screens.description: Use sue@suewheelerstl.com. A one-click sign-in link lands in your inbox in seconds.

screens.title: The Dashboard
screens.description: Every lead lives on this Kanban board. Columns represent workflow stages from New Request through Complete.

screens.title: Lead Cards
screens.description: Each card shows the client name, services, and your latest private note. Drag cards between columns to update status.

screens.title: Add a New Lead
screens.description: Click "+ New Lead" to add a client who called or walked in. Fill in name, phone, email, services, and notes.

screens.title: Lead — Contact Info
screens.description: Click "View" on any card for the full record. Contact details, status selector, and the client portal link.

screens.title: Lead — Project
screens.description: Project description, requested services, timeline, and any photos the client uploaded.

screens.title: Lead — Crew & Dates
screens.description: Assign crew members, set the start date, and mark completion milestones.

screens.title: Private Notes
screens.description: Add timestamped internal notes — call attempts, special instructions, reminders. The latest note shows on the Kanban card.

screens.title: Client Messages
screens.description: Send messages to the client. They receive an email and reply from their personal portal link.

screens.title: Bid Builder
screens.description: Build an estimate from saved copy blocks. Drag blocks into the document, set the total, attach a PDF, and send.

screens.title: Settings
screens.description: Manage crew members and archive completed or cancelled requests to keep the board clean.

screens.title: Client Contact Form
screens.description: This is suewheelerstl.com/contact — what clients fill out. Submitting creates a Kanban card and emails you immediately.
